en: Colorized panoramic view framed by two large trees, showing an expansive complex of multi‑story institutional buildings with towers and clock turrets set amid gardens, fields, and scattered houses. In the background are forested hills and distant mountains. The style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard of a hospital or similar institution. At the top, printed text in German identifies the scene as in Graz, district St. Leonhard, and refers to a new hospital.
